description: Architects Registration Board - The List of Chartered Architects Registered in ARB for the Year 2020
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the registration and renewal of registration for architects (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) for the year 2020/2021. This is a business/commercial matter involving the licensing and certification of professionals to practice their trade, which falls under the Commercial classification (Type 6). It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Elections, etc.
